items.title: Weekend bar-append UNLOCKS deterministic headless coverage without moving levels: the completed 07-31 daily bar finally posts (bars fresh through 07-31, 287/287 fresh, 0 carried), flipping 12 tools to fresh-headless newly-authored and advancing persistence to a 2nd distinct completed bar date (07-30 -> 07-31), while every price level (VIX 15.99, SPY 747.03) and the XLY rotate-into stay numerically identical to the prior 07-30-bar carry - and the lone crypto leg (BTC-USD) actually eases 31.4 -> 31.1
items.note: Distinct from the prior 'frozen weekend carry' pattern: this pre-market run consumes a NEWER snapshot (asOf 2026-08-02T11:00:24.826Z) in which the weekend batch has appended the just-closed 07-31 session. (1) DATA FRESHNESS ADVANCED: dataFreshness.bars now reports expectedSessionDate 2026-07-31 with freshSymbolCount 287 / 287, carriedSymbolCount 0, missingSymbolCount 0 (updated 2026-08-02T11:00:14.806Z) - whereas the prior after-hours window was frozen at the 07-30 completed bar with 07-31 not yet appended. So the distinct completed market-bar date advanced from 07-30 to 07-31. (2) COVERAGE EXPANDED WITHOUT LEVELS MOVING: 12 tools are now fresh-headless newly-authored (richCount 12) vs 10 coverage-only (coverageCount 10) - market-heatmap-lab (breadth 48.64% narrow), intraday-tape-lab (Trend day up, VWAP 744.46), swing-structure-lab (Bull-stacked, Double top below-threshold), options-structure-lab (positive gamma, flip 740.09, walls 741/749, EM +/-4.27), gamma-trading-lab (pin-to-maxpain, patient) and volatility-sizing-lab (forecast 13.9101%, normal, throttle x1.08) all flipped from STALE (prior window, no headless read) to ANALYZED, purely because the 07-31 bar append satisfied their completed-bar requirement. Yet the shared regime/bench are byte-identical to the prior windows and to Friday's close: VIX 15.99 (band 'VIX 16.0', score 0), SPY 747.03, ma50Dist +0.38%, ma200Dist +7.12%, -1.4% from the 52w high, mom126 +8.21%, mom252 +19.05%. (3) SECTOR READ IDENTICAL ACROSS TWO DISTINCT BARS: the XLY rotate-into (Improving quad I, accel +0.9, rsMom 100.74) with unchanged structural weakness (bear-stack, ma200Dist -0.52, rsMom1m -1.86 / rsMom3m -5.93 / rsMom6m -12.03) now repeats on both the 07-30 and 07-31 completed bars - EARLY-PERSISTENT / forming, still low-conviction. (4) LONE-MOVER DIRECTION FLIPPED: unlike the prior window where BTC-USD rose (29.3 -> 31.4), this window BTC-USD EASES 31.4 -> 31.1 (still Downtrend, asOf 2026-08-02T00:00:00.000Z) while global rotation EWS rose 82.6 -> 83.5 with its FX flipping headwind -> neutral. The signature: a completed-bar append can materially expand deterministic Tier-A coverage and legitimately advance the persistence counter even when headline levels do not move.
items.method: Add a 'bar-append unlocks coverage' detector that fires when a NEWER snapshot advances the completed-bar frontier without moving levels. Trigger on FOUR tests: (1) FRESHNESS FRONTIER ADVANCES = dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate moves forward one trading session (here 07-30 -> 07-31) with freshSymbolCount == symbolCount and carriedSymbolCount == 0 and missingSymbolCount == 0 (here 287/287, 0, 0) - a genuine completed-bar append, NOT a carry; (2) HEADLESS COVERAGE EXPANDS = the count of newly-authored/fresh-headless tool briefs rises versus the prior window (here heatmap, intraday, swing, options-structure, gamma, volatility-sizing flip STALE -> ANALYZED) with richCount/coverageCount reflecting the split (12/10); (3) LEVELS UNCHANGED = regime + bench are byte-identical to the prior window (VIX 15.99 / band 'VIX 16.0' / score 0; SPY 747.03 / +0.38% / +7.12% / +8.21% / +19.05%) and the sector RRG metrics are identical (XLY into, XLE out, XLV leader); (4) PERSISTENCE INCREMENTS LEGITIMATELY = because a NEW distinct completed bar date now exists, an identical read that spanned only the prior bar now spans TWO distinct completed bar dates and may be graded early-persistent/forming. HARD RULE: still count persistence by DISTINCT completed market-bar dates only - the append from 07-30 to 07-31 increments the counter to 2 for the unchanged XLY rotate-into (early-persistent, not durable), while an off-hours re-priced crypto quote (BTC-USD easing 31.4 -> 31.1 on its 08-02 daily stamp) is NOT a completed-equity-bar advance and does not itself increment persistence.

bars.note: The completed 07-31 daily session has now been appended (287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing), advancing the distinct completed-bar frontier from the prior after-hours window's 07-30 to 07-31 and unlocking the headless adapters that require a completed bar.

loneMover.note: Crypto daily-dated leg holds its 08-02 stamp but its score EASES 31.4 -> 31.1 (opposite direction to the prior window's 29.3 -> 31.4 rise); an off-hours quote change on the completed 07-31 equity bar, not itself a bar advance.

frozenLegs.note: Non-crypto real-asset legs and ETF momentum (JMOM 14.45%) repeat the prior windows' values; global rotation firmed (EWS 82.6 -> 83.5, FX headwind -> neutral). The material change this window is the completed-bar append and the coverage expansion it unlocked, not a level move.
